mid_campaign_correction.what: astro build, astro check and Playwright were reported blocked by Windows Application Control during Wave 0 and were treated as untestable.
mid_campaign_correction.how_surfaced: A Wave 5 falsification agent returned built-output evidence that should not have been obtainable. Direct re-verification showed the native binding now loads.
mid_campaign_correction.cause: Windows Application Control had been withholding a reputation verdict on Astro's unsigned rolldown binding; the block was transient, not permanent.
mid_campaign_correction.effect: The full quality:production sequence, built output, structured data and Playwright browser QA were then exercised. Untested failure-matrix cells fell from 9 to 4, and AV2-001 was upgraded from partly-inferred to confirmed end to end.
